methods.label: Interpret direction and distance
methods.explanation: Positive and negative signs represent opposite directions. If east is positive, a negative sign represents west. The value 3 indicates a distance of 3 m, so it means walking 3 m west.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 signed quantities with the elementary fact that east and west are opposite directions.
